records.title: DocSLM: A Small Vision-Language Model for Long Multimodal Document Understanding
records.reason: DocSLM compresses each document page into a fixed-length multimodal sequence via a Hierarchical Multimodal Compressor, reporting 82% fewer visual tokens, 75% fewer parameters and 71% lower latency for long-document VLM inference on memory-constrained edge devices.

records.title: TWIST & SCOUT: Grounding Multimodal LLM-Experts by Forget-Free Tuning
records.reason: TWIST is a twin-expert tuning module and SCOUT a synthetic dataset that teach pre-trained MLLMs visual grounding without forgetting; the contribution is capability training for grounding, with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: Optimizing Privacy-Preserving Primitives to Support LLM-Scale Applications
records.reason: Overview of hardware/software/algorithm co-design for MPC, zero-knowledge proofs and FHE at LLM scale; transformer inference under privacy primitives is only one of several contexts (DNN IP ownership, usage enforcement, private learning), and the paper is a progress overview rather than an inference system.

records.title: The Impact of Decorrelation on Transformer Interpretation Methods: Applications to Clinical Speech AI
records.reason: Studies how two decorrelation methods change Comprehensiveness and Sufficiency interpretation metrics for a BERT model in clinical speech AI; an interpretability analysis with no inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Ghost in the Transformer: Tracing LLM Lineage with SVD-Fingerprint
records.reason: GhostSpec builds SVD fingerprints from invariant products of attention weight matrices to trace LLM lineage and protect IP; model provenance verification, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: What Makes Two Language Models Think Alike?
records.reason: Maps activations of 43 language models onto interpretable linguistic features to explain representational similarity across model families; a scientific analysis paper with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Evaluating Expert Contributions in a MoE LLM for Quiz-Based Tasks
records.reason: Post-hoc evaluation of expert activation patterns and gating distributions in an MoE LLM on the MMLU quiz benchmark; capability/analysis of MoE behavior only, with no system contribution.

records.title: Revisiting Reset Mechanisms in Spiking Neural Networks for Sequential Modeling: Specialized Discretization for Binary Activated RNN
records.reason: Re-examines reset mechanisms and refractory periods in spiking neural networks viewed as binary-activated RNNs for sequential modeling; SNN theory outside LLM inference systems.

records.title: DSFT: Inspiring Diffusion Large Language Models to Comprehend Mathematical and Logical Patterns
records.reason: DSFT adjusts masking strategy and loss to teach diffusion LLMs mathematical and logical patterns, validated as a training/SFT recipe on LLaDA and Dream; training for capability, not inference.

records.title: Small Language Models using Spiking Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Review
records.reason: Comprehensive review of spiking-neural-network small language models (SpikeGPT, BrainGPT, conversion frameworks) for energy-efficient edge NLP; relevant to efficient inference but a survey with no new mechanism.

records.title: ContaGPT: A Domain-Adapted LLM for Romanian Financial and Accounting Applications
records.reason: ContaGPT is a Phi-4 model QLoRA fine-tuned on Romanian fiscal and ERP documents with a BM25/embedding RAG pipeline for financial and accounting queries; a domain-adapted application model.

records.title: Deep Learning and Computer Vision-Based System for Detecting and Separating Abnormal Bags in Automatic Bagging Machines
records.reason: Lightweight ResNet with ghost convolution and distillation that detects and separates abnormal bags inside automatic bagging machines; an industrial computer-vision quality-control application.

records.title: Agentic Neural Networks: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation
records.reason: Agentic Neural Networks organize LLM agent teams as neural-network-like layers and optimize them by textual backpropagation; a multi-agent orchestration framework, not an inference serving or execution system.

records.title: MLVTG: Mamba-Based Feature Alignment and LLM-Driven Purification for Multi-Modal Video Temporal Grounding
records.reason: MLVTG combines a Vision Mamba backbone (MambaAligner) with frozen LLM layers (LLMRefiner) to localize video clips for natural-language queries on QVHighlights/Charades-STA; a video temporal grounding task model.

records.title: Leveraging Large Language Models to Effectively Generate Visual Data for Canine Musculoskeletal Diagnoses
records.reason: Investigates whether LLMs can generate synthetic visual training data (colored strokes on a dog body map over 200 muscle/joint regions) for canine musculoskeletal diagnosis; a veterinary data-generation application.

records.title: Maple: A Multi-agent System for Portable Deep Learning across Clusters
records.reason: Maple is a four-agent system that generates correct deep-learning training command lines for heterogeneous GPU clusters and SLURM/PBS schedulers; training-workflow tooling, not inference.

records.title: LLM2IR: simple unsupervised contrastive learning makes long-context LLM great retriever
records.reason: LLM2IR uses unsupervised contrastive learning to convert decoder-only LLMs into dense retrievers evaluated on LoCo/BEIR; a training method for retrieval capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation
records.reason: xMemory decouples agent interaction history into memory components and aggregates them into a revisable hierarchy for retrieval; it is an agent-memory organization scheme whose inference-system contribution (context retrieval cost/quality) is indirect.

records.title: Supercharging Packet-level Network Simulation of Large Model Training via Memoization and Fast-Forwarding
records.reason: Wormhole accelerates packet-level discrete-event network simulation of large-model training via state memoization and steady-state fast-forwarding; a training-network simulator, adjacent to but not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: From Saliency to Discriminability: Rank-Preserving Visual Token Pruning for VLM Rerankers
records.reason: RaDiCal is a training-free visual token pruning framework for VLM listwise rerankers that fuses attention-entropy-calibrated saliency with a rank-discriminative prior, matching dense MRR@10 at a 20% visual token budget.
